analysis.title: Multi-Asset Strategy Daily
key_insights: USTs twist-flattened Monday as a large equity recovery pushed the front end cheaper while oil's sharp fall kept duration bid. 2Y finished near 4.66% and 10Y below 4.93%.
Jensen Huang/Nvidia headlines initially pushed 2Y UST yields as high as 4.73% and 10Y close to 4.98%, but dip buying was strong. The $69bn 2Y auction was well digested.
Mizuho sees 4.9-5% as the key 10Y UST range for now, with the upper end hard to break unless equities extend the rally materially.

Brent fell below $90pb on tentative US-Iran diplomatic efforts, rising inventories and signs of a global supply surplus. Markets still price at least a 25bp Fed hike in December and Williams said more work is needed on price stability.
Today's catalysts are equities, oil and the $70bn 5Y UST auction, with data second tier. DXY is around 104.30.

EGBs twist-flattened Monday, with German 10Y and 30Y yields about 3bp lower. French 10Y OATs tightened about 7bp vs Bunds after Macron's proposed fiscal golden rule, and BTPs and SPGBs tightened 2-3bp.

Mizuho warns against extrapolating the OAT move given political hurdles. Setup for duration looks constructive with oil below $90pb and light supply (€2bn DSL 29s), but Bunds may struggle to extend the rally with equities stabilising. German IFO is the main macro focus.

Gilts lagged the EGB rally, with the front end driven by expected further BoE tightening and 10s near 5.20%. GBP/USD is below 1.3050. BoE reaction function depends on energy prices, and a dovish shift is a risk but is probably too early to price in.
Asian equities caught up with US moves led by tech. JGB yields fell with the 10Y leading, and USD/JPY rose to about 159.35. EUR/USD is back near 1.09.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Front end cheapened on equity rebound after intraday high of 4.73%.
Duration bid on lower oil. Mizuho sees 4.9-5% range.
Lower geopolitical premium and supply surplus signs support rates.
Front end stays pressured and Fed speak remains hawkish.
Long end caught a bid late while front end tracks BoE tightening expectations.

risk_factors: Equity rally failing to extend or reversing would swing yields.
Oil rebound would hit duration, especially gilts, which track energy prices.
Hawkish Fed and BoE front-end repricing.
French political hurdles to the fiscal rule.
geopolitical: Tentative US-Iran diplomatic efforts reduced some geopolitical premium in oil.
Macron's proposed fiscal golden rule in France faces political hurdles.
